title: Reporting Analyst
text: Reporting Analyst at Absolute Care and Health (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Part Time; salary: not stated). Opportunity for a Reporting Analyst Absolute Care & Health is an independent in-home care provider, which gives us the freedom to innovate how we provide care for our clients. By focusing solely on in-home care, we can significantly improve outcomes for our clients with specialized services. We are dedicated to helping clients discover what happiness at home looks like for them. It's at the core of our care philosophy. With headquarters in South Yarra, we have clients in the Melbourne, Geelong, and Gippsland regions. We are looking for an experienced Reporting Analyst to work with our team in South Yarra, and assist the business with reporting processes, as we implement new systems. Responsibilities Include: · Manage data from multiple sources with a focus on accuracy. · Collaborate with stakeholders to generate accurate performance reports on a weekly, monthly and annual basis. · Effectively analyze information on performance to identify issues and provide insights on corrective actions. · Documenting reporting procedures and continually looking to optimize the performance reporting process. ·Transform data into automated reporting platforms and contribute to enhancing and streamlining performance reporting. · Assist with manual time sheeting and develop workarounds while systems are being implemented. What You'll Need to Join Our Team The successful candidate will possess; · A sincere interest in working in the Aged care/Home Care sector. ·Highly developed attention to detail and strong analytical skills. ·A continuous improvement mindset. ·A communicative and collaborative approach to working with stakeholders; both externally and across all functions internally. · A natural flair for problem solving and creative thinking. · Advanced skills in Excel are required (including report design, macros, pivot tables, data extraction). · Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite of programs, and in the use of Apple and PC equipment is essential. The successful candidate will be comfortable in an environment, which is constantly changing and growing.
